integrity: The mass/stiffness matrices are derived from the standard P1 finite-element formulas. The three-node result is proved by exact sine diagonalization and strict convexity of a scalar exponential equation; the numerical threshold is only a reported evaluation of a uniquely characterized exact root.
scientific_limitations: The exact threshold classification is proved only for uniform one-dimensional standard Galerkin heat semidiscretizations with one, two, or three interior nodes. No all-N threshold formula, nonuniform-mesh theorem, or fully discrete positivity claim is made.
title: Three interior nodes are the first uniform one-dimensional Galerkin heat mesh with transient negativity
